protocol.summary: Yellow wire accepts a PWM square wave. Official product recommends 4kHz at half duty and explicitly forbids a sustained DC high. Official BuzzerUnit delegates to Haptic at 4000Hz.
gaps: A frequency/duty observer does not establish acoustic sound pressure or spectral fidelity.
